segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, yeah, this is Priya at Northline Foods. We need to add 6 more user seats to our workspace before our March 18 go-live. Can you help with that?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Absolutely. I can take care of that. I’m pulling up your account in the admin console now. Is this for Northline Foods, account ending in 4821?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that’s the one. We’re currently at 34 seats and need to be at 40.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I see 34 active seats on the Business plan. Adding 6 seats will prorate for the current billing period, March 1 through March 31. The prorated amount is $174.20, and then your monthly total will be $1,160 starting April 1. Does that look okay?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that’s fine. Same card on file, please.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, I’ve added the 6 seats and charged the prorated amount to the card ending in 9094. The receipt is generated under invoice 118734, and it’ll also be emailed to billing@northlinefoods.com.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Do I need to do anything before inviting the new users?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Nope, you’re all set. The admin console now shows 40 seats available, with 34 assigned and 6 open. You can invite them whenever you’re ready.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, thanks for the quick help.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. I’ll close ticket 462918 as completed. Have a good one.
